name: The Butcher
caption: A psychotic butcher with early-stage OCD who took the hWo National Championship at Scarred For Life on 17 July 2005 and fought Payne Fosters again at Vendetta 1.

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own forum threads and site, 2005-07-08 to 2005-07-25.

identity.note: A common ring name: a 1991 WEWF broadcast figure and a 2002 XHCW brawler. Nothing links them to this psychotic butcher.

name: Streets
caption: A camouflage-clad, self-assured ladies' man booked against Kenny Davis at Scarred For Life and Julius Fristik at Vendetta 1.

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own forum threads, 9 to 19 July 2005.

name: Kenny Davis
caption: A chain-smoking small-town man called KD, whose roleplay for Scarred For Life opens in a storm; booked against Streets.

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own forum threads and site, 2005-07-09 to 2005-07-11.

identity.note: The initials K.D. match the UWF wing's 'Kinda Decent K.D.' (2002 to 2003), a commentator; nothing else does.

name: Ken Kaze
caption: Booked against Alchemist at Scarred For Life.

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own forum threads and site, 2005-07-09 to 2005-07-09.

identity.note: Same name as the PCW wing's Ken Kaze (December 2001 to January 2002); a held get-to-know thread has a player placing a character of that name in the PWA and PCW circle of those years. Lead only.

name: Alchemist
caption: Ken Kaze's opponent at Scarred For Life.

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own forum threads and site, 2005-07-09 to 2005-07-09.

name: Arnold Crumpet
caption: A cruiserweight in a purple-furred caveman singlet, a failed football mascot with a pet goat and a ringside friend who sells vegetables.

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own forum threads and site, 2005-07-09 to 2005-07-09.

name: Spade
caption: Fourth in the fed's ranking of wrestlers on its home page.

tenures.source: Named in the fed's home page captured 5 August 2005.

identity.note: A bare shared ring name with another federation's wrestler; nothing else in either record ties them.

name: Jack Foley
caption: The scheming owner's figure of Vendetta 6 who demands that the champion hand over his title and has him beaten.

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own forum threads and site, 2005-09-27 to 2005-09-27.

name: Ron White
caption: One of Jack Foley's four men at Vendetta 6.

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own forum threads and site, 2005-09-27 to 2005-09-27.

name: Madd Miller
caption: One of Jack Foley's four men at Vendetta 6.

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own forum threads and site, 2005-09-27 to 2005-09-27.

name: Stitches
caption: One of Jack Foley's four men at Vendetta 6.

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own forum threads and site, 2005-09-27 to 2005-09-27.

name: Trevor Echo
caption: The former owner who returns at Vendetta 6 with ten men to take Jack Foley's crew backstage.

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own forum threads and site, 2005-09-27 to 2005-09-27.

name: Davis Echo
caption: The owner who 'will resume ownership once again' after Vendetta 6.

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own forum threads and site, 2005-09-27 to 2005-09-27.

name: Dusty Sweets
caption: The writer of the home page's news item on the first pay-per-view.

tenures.source: Named as the byline of a news item posted 18 July 2005, on the home page captured 5 August 2005.
